cases.prompt: Կուբրիկի ոճով 30 վայրկյանանոց տեսարան սարքի. ծեր պահակը գիշերը շրջում է դատարկ թանգարանում ու հայտնաբերում, որ նկարներից մեկի կերպարը նայում է իրեն։ Seedance 2.5, 16:9։
expect: replies in Armenian; all prompts in English; no director name inside any prompt
brief shows shot-budget math from the Kubrick ASL
departments run in order 00→10 and each writes its document
editor's plan precedes the shot list and has one handoff contract per cut
camera moves are specific paths (rig, height, speed, end frame), Kubrick-derived (one-point perspective, slow glide, zoom-out), not generic
locked SET/LOOK/LIGHT blocks reused verbatim across storyboard cards
generation plan names a chaining method per cut and fits Seedance 2.5 limits
review includes a virtual-cut line for every cut

cases.prompt: Tarantino-style 45-second scene for Reels: two hitmen and a waitress in a roadside diner; she clearly knows more than she says. Make it cut together.
expect: long held conversation shots then a hard cut rupture, chapter card or circling track used with intent
axis map for the booth conversation and eyelines in the contracts
no gore; clean-output phrase in clips; needle drop planned for the edit, not generated
